# The Law Offices of Dr. Bruce G. Fagel & Associates

> A Los Angeles-based medical malpractice law firm specializing in birth injuries, surgical errors, and hospital liability cases across California, Nevada, and Arizona.

Led by Dr. Bruce G. Fagel, an attorney with unique medical credentials, the firm represents clients in complex medical malpractice litigation. The firm has established a strong reputation for significant jury verdicts and case results, particularly in birth injury and hospital negligence matters.
